criteria.rationale: Born December 18, 1983, the patient was 42 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
Wegovy is requested for chronic weight management in a patient seeking medication for excess body weight.
The August 8 note documents ongoing diet and gym activity and directs the patient to continue both with Wegovy; the May note confirms the meal plan and gym routine.

A reduced-calorie diet and exercise plan began January 24, with dietitian-led program intake February 7 and documented continuation and follow-up through August 8. Even measured from the February 7 intake, continuous participation exceeds six whole calendar months.
The latest structured BMI before the request is 32.5 kg/m², meeting the ≥30 threshold without a comorbidity requirement.
